name: AI team · fast with an architecture
summary: The fast team inside a lasting architecture: an Architect (a stronger model) designs the modules, their dependency rules and contracts once; the Builder builds inside them, and the system rejects imports that break the rules.
steps: Architect designs modules, rules and contracts (only when the project has none)
Builder plans and codes, QA writes hidden tests (at the same time)
System runs both test sets and checks the imports → Builder fixes if failing (max 5 rounds)
